selected_agent_config.name: A1_dense_neighbours
selected_agent_config.hypothesis: Dev error q06: the answer sits in the chunk right after the retrieved one (Day 6 chunk boundary). Adding prev/next chunks of the top-2 raises context evidence at same budget.

baseline_agent_config.name: A0_dense
baseline_agent_config.hypothesis: Baseline agent: model-written queries over Day 6 dense search, top-3, no neighbours.

retrieval_selection_rule: 1) highest dev Evidence Hit@3 on the original question pipeline; 2) tie -> highest dev Hit@1; 3) tie -> lower cost per query, then lower median latency.
agent_selection_rule: 1) highest dev (Context Evidence Rate on answerable + correct abstentions on unanswerable), counted automatically from traces; 2) tie -> fewer false abstentions; 3) tie -> lower cost per query; the chosen config and the baseline are then graded manually on dev before freezing.

dev_evidence.agent: A1 and A2 tie on selection score 23 (20/20 context + 3/3 abstention), 0 false abstentions each; A1 cheaper ($0.0133 vs $0.0258 on dev). Manual dev grades: A1 1.95/2, A0 1.85/2.
